# Copilot Instructions

See **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** in the repository root.

That file is the single authoritative working agreement for AI agents in this repository —
setup, the required checks, the safety and correctness rules, the output contract, and the
conventions for hardware and pull requests.

This file used to carry its own 34 KB copy of that guidance. Two documents describing the same
rules drifted apart, and the copy went on describing fabricated health data, a stubbed
full-capacity test, and data paths that had moved. One home, no duplication.
